column1: # Energy Research Warehouse (ERW): the hours behind What a datacenter pays; the default case of /cost-of-power (session 190)
# Case: ERCOT; the North load zone LZ_NORTH; a flat load; bought in real time; per 1 MW of load (the page's default size is 100 MW). A zone price is an average over many points: not a site

# Window: every hour from 2015-01-01T06:00:00Z to 2026-10-25T04:00:00Z: the first to the last hour the page's files hold of LZ_NORTH in real time. in_last_twelve = 1 marks 2025-10 to 2026-09: the page's last twelve months

# Rows: one per hour of the window (103559 rows); hour_utc is the hour's start. Hours are counted in US Central standard time all year (UTC less 6 hours; no daylight saving shift): std_month is the hour's month on that clock; every day has 24 hours
# rt_usd_mwh: the real-time settlement point price of LZ_NORTH in USD per MWh; the mean of the hour's four 15-minute prices; held only when all four are; to the cent

# da_usd_mwh: the day-ahead settlement point price of LZ_NORTH for the hour in USD per MWh. hub_rt_usd_mwh: the real-time price of the trading hub the page shows beside the zone (HB_NORTH); made as rt_usd_mwh is
# Sentinel: -99999 in rt_usd_mwh or da_usd_mwh or hub_rt_usd_mwh means the price of that hour is not held (0 and 0 and 24 hours in this file); such an hour is in no sum and is never filled

# The page's arithmetic: a flat load pays the mean of the hourly prices held; a month counts when at least 0.95 of its calendar hours are held; the last twelve months are the newest twelve counted months in a row; a bad month is the month at the top tenth by cost per MWh (nearest rank) of the counted months among the 36 that end with the last twelve

# Source tables (ERW; warehouse/output): LZ_NORTH from ercot_zone_prices_history (ERCOT NP4-180-ER day-ahead and NP6-785-ER real time); HB_NORTH from ercot_all_hub_prices_history; iso_rtm_hub_prices (the same two reports; and ERCOT NP6-905-CD for the newest days)

# Last run (UTC) of each table as warehouse/metadata/coverage.csv stated it at export: ercot_zone_prices_history 2026-10-25T17:44:27Z; ercot_all_hub_prices_history 2026-09-26T00:09:58Z; iso_rtm_hub_prices 2026-10-25T14:18:39Z

# Read from the page's own files: site/data/datacenter/index.json (built 2026-10-25T17:48:40Z; sha256 c90205d2e1d3d3ed) and ercot_2015.json to ercot_2026.json; written by warehouse/derived/datacenter_page.py (sha256 13a3388b8e04355a). No table is read at export

# Check at export; from these rows as written: every hour's three prices are the files' own; each of 142 months gives the hours held and the sum of prices the page computes (141 months counted); in_last_twelve marks the page's twelve months
